recipes.name: Lasagna inspired by Garfield (feat. It's Alive with Brad)
instructions: Add some olive oil to a large pot over medium high heat, and add the beef, pork, and veal. Cook to render the fat out of it, and strain it over a large bowl. Set aside the meat and the fat. - olive oil as needed - 1 lb pork - 1 lb beef - 1 lb veal
In a small bowl, dissolve gelatin in chicken stock. - 1 packet clear gelatin - 2 cups chicken stock

Using some of the reserved fat, add chopped onion, large chopped carrot, and celery stalks. You can also add a few optional shakes of red pepper flakes if you’re feeling saucy (pun intended), and a healthy pinch of oregano. Stir to combine. - 1 chopped onion - 1 chopped carrot - 2 stalks chopped celery - red pepper flakes (optional) - oregano

Add garlic and sauté for one minute. Deglaze mixture with wine, scraping the delicious fond off of the bottom of the pot before adding back meat mixture. - 4 cloves garlic - 2 cups white wine - 1 lb pork - 1 lb beef - 1 lb veal

Add homemade chicken stock or chicken stock in which you’ve dissolved a packet of gelatin, along with canned peeled whole tomatoes, canned diced tomatoes, some chopped sage, a few sprigs of fresh basil, milk, and bay leaves. Stir to combine. - 2 cups chicken stock - 1 packet clear gelatin - 1 can (28 oz; 800g) peeled whole tomatoes - 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes - chopped sage - 3 sprigs fresh basil - 1 ½ cups of milk - 2 bay leaves
Cover and slow simmer sauce for 4 hours. Alternatively, you could also bake the sauce with the lid partially open in a 325°F oven for about 4 hours.

Once everything is thick and cohesive, remove sprigs of basil, and add freshly chopped basil, heavy cream, and grated parmesan. Stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper. - ½ cup heavy cream - 3 sprigs fresh basil - ½ cup freshly chopped basil - salt to taste - pepper to taste
Set on the back burner and start working on your fresh pasta. - For the Sauce
Basics With Babish: Pasta - https://www.babi.sh/recipes/sauces-9w5tm-2njph?search=pasta - pasta as needed
"It’s Alive with Brad Leone" episode on how to make ricotta cheese with Babish if you want fresh ricotta: https://youtu.be/nMYopbutSgs?si=50pcH54OoAyz3zeJ - ricotta cheese as needed

Once your pasta is made, start layering your baking dish. First layer sauce, then pasta, then mozzarella cheese, then ricotta cheese. Repeat this until you reach the top and add some grated parmesan cheese. Place the baking dish on a baking sheet and cook in your oven for 45 minutes. - For the Sauce - pasta as needed - mozzarella cheese as needed - ricotta cheese as needed - 3 oz grated parmesan
Once cooked, remove from the oven, let cool for 30 minutes. Dig in and enjoy!
